# Renewal window inversion

`customer_support.df.churn_signal_detection.renewal_window_inversion` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **decision_framework**

> Renewal-window inversion — read the support history backwards from the renewal date rather than forwards from today.

Recall is weighted towards the recent and the humiliating, not towards the average, so reading forwards produces a fair summary of a period the customer will not remember fairly. Reading backwards reconstructs what they will actually bring to the conversation.
